dedupe_keys.name: cox s bazar refugee settlement roads and footpaths

description: Cox's Bazar Refugee Settlement Roads and Footpaths is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by REACH Initiative. Satellite and UAV imagery derived roads and footpaths of Rohingya refugee settlements in Cox's Bazar District, Bangladesh. Based on best available imagery acquired in October 2017. Coverage: Bangladesh. The portal files it under the publisher REACH Initiative. Its tags are displacement, facilities-infrastructure, geodata, populated places-settlements, refugee crisis. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
